head: c2f9014bee20b1f2ae46f84eb0795237178e01ef
classification_reasons: Spec is now tight: both items under spec.md's Flagged concerns close with a stated rule ('decided (PROGRESS choice 134): ...') instead of a guess, and intent.md's five open questions were already answered before this round; no open concern remains.

Blast radius stays large for the eventual phase (c) build this design describes: plan.md's own 'Files that change' lists ~23 docs/notes/ files, 26 docs/decisions/ files, 14 docs/progress/ files, 3 new index.md files, 2 rewritten stubs and edits to 4 live docs plus a new docs/PROGRESS.md entry -- not 'few files' under the routine test, even though this particular fix round itself only touches spec.md, plan.md and two evidence files.

No risk_list item and no schema/contract change (confirmed against sdlc.yaml; no plugin/ or template/ file in scope), but the design is still deferred -- phase (c) runs only after sessions 15-16 close Milestone 1, against whatever file/section counts exist then -- so the tighter non-routine gate stays appropriate for the eventual build.
attempted: Intent: re-compared the fixed spec.md/plan.md against intent.md's Proposed outcome and Constraints; the fix only resolves the two flagged concerns per the owner's PR #90 review comment and does not touch intent.md (decision 22, confirmed by fix-response.md and by intent.md being absent from the diff) or drift the problem toward anything new.

Spec and plan: verified both flagged concerns in spec.md now start with 'decided (PROGRESS choice 134): ...' and state concrete rules (number-only file names for docs/notes/<N>.md, docs/decisions/<N>.md, docs/progress/session-<N>.md / session-<N>-sitting-<M>.md and the one named non-session file; ascending-number index order, one line per file, original heading as description, no topic/tag grouping). Grepped spec.md and plan.md for leftover 'slug' and 'grouped by session/topic' text: every remaining 'slug' hit is part of the new 'no slug' / 'derives no slug' phrasing, none is a stale placeholder. Cross-checked every location the owner's review comment named (spec.md Requirements, Design, Acceptance incl. the 'grouped by session' -> 'in session order, one line per file' Acceptance rewrite; plan.md Files-that-change, Order-of-work steps 1-4, and the Risks paragraph on slugs) and found each one updated consistently with the decided rule, with no file left on the old <N>-<slug>.md / grouped-by-session wording.

Proof: this fix touches only changes/0001-.../spec.md, plan.md and evidence/fix-requests.json, fix-response.md -- a docs/spec-only edit with no code or test surface; fix-response.md's claims about what was edited and where match what grep and direct reading of the current spec.md/plan.md show, so the response is not an unverified claim. No test.log/build.log/lint.log is expected or owed for this phase-b fix round; the pre-existing, sandbox-only pytest failure recorded in the prior gate-b.json (a permission error copying tests/fixtures/sample-python-project/.env, unrelated to this docs diff) is a deterministic-check matter for the gate to re-run, not something I am citing as a reason here.

Blast radius: the diff stays inside changes/0001-split-the-large-docs-with-an-index-each/ (spec.md, plan.md, evidence/fix-requests.json, evidence/fix-response.md, plus status.yaml/hook-log.jsonl/diff-b.patch bookkeeping); no guardrail file (.claude/**, CLAUDE.md, REVIEW.md, sdlc.yaml) and nothing under plugin/ or template/ is touched.

Policies: security-baseline/data-conventions/ux-conventions/definition-of-done are unaffected by this round -- it only rewords two spec/plan sections with naming and ordering rules already using existing platform facts; nothing new is introduced that would trigger any of the five skills beyond what the already-reviewed base design covered.
Tests: change_type is 'feature' (not 'fix'), so the test-file-lock rule does not apply; no file under tests/ is touched by this diff, so there is nothing to check for weakened pre-existing tests.
